item.tib: gsas mkhar mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum yang snying bcud du dril ba'i sgrubs pa las tsak+Shi'i rgyab yig byin rlabs gru char
item.coloph: bla ma'i thugs 'dzab yab rgyud ltar gdags pa 'di yang / mchog lnga'i bla ma'i thugs 'dzab dang mthun 'dug gshis/ rten 'brel ched du sbyar nas shar grol smin gling du/ tshe dbang bde chen snying pos 'phral du sbyar ba'o//
